column3: A JSON float of 1e16 or more is read as an int: state `1e+16` becomes `10000000000000000`, `1.5e+300` raises `InvalidStateError`, attribute equality is wrong both ways (`1e23` vs `10**23`). README 294-295 documents a narrower case.
State `-0.0` becomes `"0.0"`.
`async_set_internal` with a Unicode-digit id answers `InvalidEntityFormatError` (an HA error class) where HA creates the entity; the documented answer for non-ASCII ids is `unsupported`.
Driver reads a non-bool `force_update` (`1`) as false.
Lone surrogates become U+FFFD in the drivers, so different strings compare equal (state, attributes, event type).
Generated-context numbering counts events only HA's own listeners saw (`#1` where the harness has `#0`).
`Filter.eq` compares decimal text: `1e23 == 10**23` is true in HALean, false in Python.
`ServiceNotFound` message: a domain containing `{service}` is substituted twice.
Driver keeps `Context(id="")` as id `''`; HA draws a fresh ULID.
Handler spec with more than one of `return`/`echo`/`raise`: driver and shipped harness pick different ones.
`float()` of text with a huge exponent (`"1e9999999999"`) kills the engine process (`INTERNAL PANIC: Nat.pow exponent is too big`); HA returns `inf`. Same root cause as TPL-47.

After a schema's 50th validation probatio's generated code raises `OverflowError` for `Coerce(float)` of an int ≥ 2^1024; HALean says `expected float`. README 648-652 says the generated path behaves like the interpreted one.
`TypeError` text for a timedelta in `cv.entity_ids`: `'timedelta' object is not iterable` vs HA's `'datetime.timedelta' object is not iterable`. Theorem `pyIter_error` states the model's text.
Decoder accepts `at_least_one: []`; `probatio.AtLeastOne()` raises `SchemaError`.
String escapes `\ooo`, `\u`, `\U`, `\N{}` are not decoded (Jinja literals and `literal_eval`).
Dict keys: equal keys are not merged; unhashable keys are accepted.
`dict.keys()/values()/items()` are lists (HA: `dict_keys(...)`).
`bool()` of `states` / `states.<domain>` is always true and records no lifecycle; the `if value:` guard of map/select is missing.
`last` / `reverse` over states objects differ (HA: None or an error).
The case-insensitive entity-id fallback of `hass.states.get` is missing in `states()`, `is_state`, `state_attr`, `has_value`, `states[...]`.
Float `sum` is not compensated (Python ≥ 3.12): `[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 1e100, -1e100] | sum` is 0.6 in HA, 0.0 in HALean.
Undefined inside a printed container prints as `''`, not `Undefined`.
Namespace `repr` differs.
`loop` is a dict: repr, mapping test, length, iteration, `depth` differ; `cycle`/`changed` are missing; it is assignable.
for-else: HA runs `else` unless an iteration reached the end of the body (break/continue); HALean does not.
Generators can be consumed twice.
Generators are evaluated eagerly: errors and RenderInfo for unconsumed items.
Tests `sequence` / `iterable` are wrong for range, generators, states, Undefined.
`float()` / `is_number`: whitespace (`\v`, `\f`, `\x1c`-`\x1f`, NBSP) and Unicode digits.
`_parse_result`: `\d` matches Unicode digits in HA.
Static templates are stripped with an ASCII-only `trim`.
`title` filter: word break on `\s` vs four whitespace characters.
`str.split(None, maxsplit)` strips the remainder.
Float `//` and `%` with infinite operands.
`timestamp_custom` default format is `%Y-%m-%d` (HA: `%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S`).
`as_datetime('…T24:00:00')` gives None (ciso8601 gives the next day). The patch turns it into a refusal.
`strftime` `%Y` / `%F` are not zero-padded below year 1000.
JSON numbers with an exponent (`1e+20`) become ints (variables, attributes). Same root cause as ST-1.
`literal_eval` results: set becomes a list; bytes, `...`, `set()` stay strings; a complex in a container is an error.
`literal_eval` accepts nested unary signs inside containers.
Lexer accepts `.5` and `007`.
Parser accepts invalid Jinja: a conditional expression in an `if` test, assignment to `none`/`true`/`loop`, break/continue outside a loop.
`OverflowError` (int to float, float pow, round precision, timedelta range) and the 4300-digit int/str limit are not raised.
Argument counts and keywords are not checked (filters, tests, functions, methods); `startswith(x, start)` ignores `start` (a different value).
A non-string / Undefined entity id returns False/None where HA raises.
`sum(start='')` over strings is accepted.
`timestamp_local/utc/custom` are accepted as global functions.
Errors HA does not catch (`OverflowError`/`OSError` of `fromtimestamp`, Undefined) are treated as "use default".
Jinja compile-time constant folding: `'x' | states` records no entity in HA; `'nan' | float` in `set` is a NameError in HA.
Huge float exponent: `'1e1000000000' | float` takes 27 s; `1e4000000000` aborts the engine. Same root cause as SCH-1.
`restart` with a live run: HA starts the new run one loop iteration later; HALean starts it at once and runs extra actions.
State trigger `to`/`from: "*"` is match-all in HA, literal text in HALean.
Attribute values are compared by JSON equality, not Python `==` (`1 == True == 1.0`).
Entity ids in triggers/conditions are not lower-cased or validated.
A duplicate entry in `entity_id` / `at` / `event_type` fires twice in HA, once in HALean.
Static float `repeat.count`: `2.5` runs 25 times, `3.0` 30 times (HA: 2, 3).
`continue_on_error` / stop `error` given as `"true"` or `1` are false in HALean.
Assigning `repeat` inside a loop leaks to the run variables (HA: loop-local).
A time / time_pattern trigger for the second the automations load in fires in HA, never in HALean.
`initial_state: false` is ignored: the automation triggers.
HA caches condition checkers by `str()` of their values (`state: 1` and `state: "1"` share one); HALean evaluates each.
`numeric_state` reads `"1_1"` and non-ASCII digits as non-numbers.

Configs HA's schemas reject are run: unknown keys, missing required keys, `trigger`+`triggers`, invalid condition forms, `above > below`, `from`+`not_from`, bad weekday, int trigger `id` (also seen for script actions: SCR-11).
Static time periods use an ad-hoc parser: accepts `{secs: 1}`, `{}`, `"0.5:00"`, `{weeks: 1}`; refuses `delay: true`.
Two automations with the same `id` both run (HA ignores the second).
Shipped harness merges `data` over `target` (HA: target wins).
Harness `_walk_actions` misses mapping-form `action:` and list-form parallel branches (services unregistered, events unobserved).
Harness fires HA timers due in one tick in heap order and up to 0.5 s early. README 675-677 mentions part of it.
Scenario format lets a call with `response_variable` be answered `ok` without a response; HA raises.
`tests/run_scenarios.py::build` sends `state_changed` for a `set` that changes nothing; HA fires none.
A run restarted while its `parallel` branches are scheduled but not started: HA still runs each branch to its first wait; HALean drops them.
Time condition with a timestamp sensor whose state is a date only (`2023-11-14`): HA says true, HALean silently says false.

A call to a missing service with `continue_on_error: true`: HA ends the run (`ServiceNotFound` is in `CONFIGURATION_ERRORS`); the bridge reports `not_found` as `ha_error` and the engine goes on. The shipped live test asserts the HALean behaviour.
A static `target.entity_id` is sent as written (`"Light.A, light.b"`); HA normalises it to `['light.a', 'light.b']` and rejects an invalid id at load.
`turn_on`/`turn_off`/`toggle` with an invalid `entity_id` fails with kind `other`; HA gives `invalid` (the kind decides whether `continue_on_error` applies).
`metadata` of any type is accepted by `turn_on`; HA requires a dict.
`toggle` decides start/stop for every target before acting; HA reads `is_on` when each target's turn comes.
A stop (`turn_off`, `toggle`, `restart`) is complete at once; in HA it takes event-loop iterations (other order, missing events, an extra run).
A run stopped from inside its own `script.turn_on` step is reported cancelled; in HA it ends quietly and its caller goes on.
After the caller of a queued, waiting run is cancelled, HA keeps `current` one too high until the next write; HALean writes the exact count.
Reload is one atomic step; in HA a waiting script resumes mid-reload and its call of the changed script is `ServiceNotFound`.
`last_action` is readable by listing `states.script.x.attributes`; the load check only looks for the word. README 506 documents only the direct use.
A `script.*` service HALean does not own is sent to HA; the harness has no HA to answer.
Two delays ending in the same harness tick: outcome and order follow asyncio's timer heap in the harness.
A `result` step without `response` for a call that asked for one: the harness's HA handler returns `None` and HA raises.
A run stopped in a top-level `parallel` step ends quietly; HA re-raises a finished branch's `stop` (response) or error.
`entity_id: all` runs the service on the entities of every helper domain (`input_boolean.toggle` on `all` resets counters).
`input_number`: HA keeps `-0.0` when `0.0` is set; HALean replaces it and fires `state_changed`.
A state longer than 255 characters is `unknown` in HA; HALean writes it.
`input_select`: the duplicate-options warning of a valid item is lost when another item makes the config invalid.
Pattern with a quantifier after `$` (`a$*`): Python raises, HALean accepts.
Pattern `{m}` / `{m,n}` with nothing to repeat: Python raises, HALean reads literals.
Pattern with a class escape before `-` in a set (`[\d-z]`): Python raises, HALean accepts.
Pattern `[]-a]`: a leading `]` starting a range is parsed as three literals.
`\s` does not match U+001C..U+001F, which Python's `\s` matches.
`input_text`: a non-ASCII initial or restored value against `\d \w \s` is matched with ASCII classes; the entity is silently not added. README 551 claims a refusal.
`input_number` restore: `float()` of Unicode digits or `\x0b`/`\x0c` padding gives `min` instead of the value.
Timer: start/change whose end leaves `datetime`'s range raises `OverflowError` in HA; HALean starts the timer.
Timer restore: a `last_transition` that is not a string is dropped; HA keeps it.
`input_select` duplicate warning prints `''` instead of `<unnamed>` for `name: ""`.
An empty config key `""`: HA adds no entity, HALean adds `input_boolean.`.
